diagnostics.note: Diagnostic values are assumptions, not manufacturer maxima or fitted driver behavior. A gate threshold is not the VGS=0 leakage guarantee.

hybrid_boundary.drive: Discrete common-source pair only after a bounded current-source pull-up/discharge circuit exists
hybrid_boundary.sense: AQY232G3HSX isolated contact from previous candidate, zero galvanic gate-bias current into FB
hybrid_boundary.scope: 16 precision outputs only; the other 66 outputs and 30 reference connections remain separate obligations
hybrid_boundary.enabled_gate_current_return: Conservatively charge drive gate/clamp current to +12 V and amplifier sink return on -12 V; base current additionally charges +12 V
hybrid_boundary.sense_LED_grouping_sensitivity: Eight two-LED strings at 5 mA on +5 V for 16 sense contacts; real current driver/grouping not captured

open_obligations: Common-source body diodes and source-referenced R_GS remove the literal grounded-gate negative-jack error; leakage, displacement current, source motion and all partial-power cases still require a physical proof.

The resistive PNP pull-up injects its complete bleed AND Zener current into SOURCE_COMMON. The sense variant creates uncompensated DC transfer error; its coupled nominal driver countermodel additionally requires amplifier swing outside the rails. Do not confuse static offset with the original loaded-versus-unloaded error criterion.
The resistive pull-up has large signal-dependent clamp current; use a bounded current source for a viable drive-only hybrid. No current-source circuit is selected here.
D_BLOCK prevents a positive floating source/gate from forward-biasing Q_UP's collector-base junction into an absent rail; its actual reverse recovery and capacitance require inclusion.
BSS138N charge/capacitance/switching maxima use specific 25 C test trajectories. Clamp charge, driver stored charge, Miller injection and source movement are not bounded over the project envelope.
Q_UP's 300 ns storage-plus-fall maximum requires 1 mA reverse base current. The default-off 100 kohm base-emitter resistor does not reproduce that test.
A complete timing bound, independent rail/reference/GND permit, per-board reachable capacitance, aggregate cold-collapse concurrency and installed thermal/physical layout are absent.

A 15 ms minimum soft-start is a possible future source requirement, not a source-contract edit or a substitute for fast shutdown. Original current/voltage/capacitance/return/drop ceilings remain unchanged.
VOM1271T is an exact current-neutral floating-drive alternative, but its retained turn-off figure is typical only, not a maximum; it does not close the timing gap.
